name: Rental advice holdouts

cases.situation: A drill has a current inspection and no reported damage.

rubric.expectation: May use subject to normal checks; do not invent missing facts.

cases.situation: A sander has a current inspection. Damage status is unknown.

rubric.expectation: Ask whether damage is reported and withhold use advice.

cases.situation: A saw has an overdue inspection and reported damage.

knowledge_a:
# Tool inspection
A current inspection is required. Ask for unknown damage status.
knowledge_b:
# Tool inspection
A current inspection and confirmed damage report are required.
